title: Brazil in the Top 5 for Economic Growth Despite a Slowdown: What Does This Reveal About the Global Landscape?
summary: With GDP growth of 0.5% in the second quarter, Brazil ranked fifth in a survey that compared quarterly economic growth across 50 countries during the same period.
